name: BatchPanel
description: Choose local files and run an injected renderer with per-file results. The host owns delivery.
signature: ({ sources: controlled, defaultSources, onSourcesChange, settings: provided, onSettingsChange, renderOne, onComplete, runBatch, concurrency, labels }: BatchPanelProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ size: string; export: string; metadata: string; batch: string; format: string; quality: string; width: string; height: string; alpha: string; preserve: string; strip: string; stripGps: string; preview: string; bytes: string; unavailable: string; loading: string; failed: string; open: string; projectOpen: string; projectSave: string; paste: string; copy: string; drop: string; browse: string; run: string; cancel: string; files: string; progress: string; empty: string; cameraMake: string; cameraModel: string; lens: string; exposureSeconds: string; aperture: string; iso: string; focalLengthMm: string; date: string; orientation: string; gps: string; profile: string; recover: string; autosave: string; pending: string; done: string; error: string; aborted: string; noExport: string; icc: string; iccNote: string; profileFallback: string; rawPreview: string; project: string; recovery: string; sources: string; }> | undefined

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Receives every result. The host chooses whether to save successful files.

props.name: onSettingsChange
props.description: Report edited format, quality and dimensions.
